title: Weather Data Aggregator
objectives: Build a REST API that aggregates weather data from multiple sources
Implement request rate limiting and concurrent request management
Handle API failures gracefully with fallback strategies
requirements: Create HTTP server that accepts GET /weather?city=<name> requests
Aggregate data from at least 2 weather APIs
Implement concurrent request limiting (max 5 simultaneous requests)
Cache responses for 10 minutes to reduce API calls
Return unified JSON response with temperature, humidity, and description
Handle network errors and API rate limits gracefully
stretchGoals: Implement webhook notifications for weather alerts
Add metrics collection and monitoring endpoints
Support batch requests for multiple cities
constraints: Use only native Node.js modules (http, fetch)
No external HTTP libraries like axios or request
Implement custom rate limiting without external packages
Memory cache only (no Redis or external storage)
